summary: Wednesday's close showed a firmer dollar and elevated real yields pressuring gold to a fresh 14-day low with RSI deep oversold, while Treasuries sold off and the curve steepened. Equities held a mild tech-led bid, but breadth stayed thin as the average stock lagged the index sharply.
tweet: Dollar strength and rising real yields hammered gold and bonds Wednesday while a narrow tech bid kept equities afloat despite weak breadth.
